baseline.company_ja: サンケイリアルエステート投資法人
baseline.window: 2026-10-16: entry before the release (this sealed spot if it lands before the 15:30 JST close, else the close) -> next session close

options.reason: No liquid single-stock option market in Japan for this name. JPX option volume is concentrated in the index, so there is no event-implied move and no skew. Until 2026-09-18 that left priced_lean_pct as -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, which is ALSO the free control, so the baseline's lean and its own benchmark were the same number. They are no longer: `positioning` and `expected_move` below carry substitutes built from what Tokyo does publish, and this baseline supplies its own `priced_lean_pct` and `anchor_quality`.

history.caveat: Announcement DATES are estimated by applying this quarter's notified lag backwards to prior period ends; the move is the largest within +/-2 trading days of that estimate. This is a cadence prior, not a record that a print happened on that date. Use it as a scale for how much this name moves, never as evidence about a particular past date.

event_plausibility.basis: issuer-notified date carried by JPX on the 決算発表予定日 sheet

positioning.basis: absent from the JPX register, so no disclosed position at or above the 0.5% threshold. A real zero, not missing data -- but the threshold truncates, so 0.4% and 0.0% are both recorded here as 0.0.
positioning.margin_ratio_basis: 信用倍率, margin long balance / margin short balance, scraped from a broker portal rather than published by the exchange. Null is a normal outcome.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of twelve ESTIMATED prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. It is NOT an option-implied move: nothing is paying for it, and it carries no information about what the market expects from THIS print. It is a scale for how far this name travels.

baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. Read researcher_japan/scripts/jp_priced_in.py, lean_components(): every weight is a PRIOR, none is measured on Japanese data, and jp_resolve.py ranks each component separately so measurement can replace them. What matters today is only that this is no longer identical to -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, so the free control is a real rival again.

anchor_quality.basis: magnitude: realised vol plus an estimated-cadence reaction history, capped at 0.5 because neither is an option-implied move. direction: how many of the three positioning components resolved, capped at 0.60 because none of them is 25-delta skew.

first_hunter_context.bar: The company's own revised FP Aug-2026 forecast of 2026-09-25: ordinary profit JPY 1.79bn (up 7.9% from JPY 1.66bn), distribution JPY 3,681 per unit (from JPY 3,560). It was filed 25 days after the period closed, so it is effectively the result. https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2972&b=k202609250012 (revision PDF https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925539836/). No 四季報 or IFIS number found, and none matters under a fixed-price tender.
first_hunter_context.positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-15: no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, short_ratio 0.0 and no change. margin_ratio null in the baseline, and kabutan shows 信用倍率 '－'. No option skew exists. The run_up_20d of +19.26% is the tender premium (JPY 107,200 close on 09-25 to JPY 125,200 on 09-28), not momentum. Since then the stock has closed between 125,000 and 125,400 on every session, including 2026-10-15 when the Nikkei fell 3,318 yen (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2972.T?range=1mo&interval=1d). Nomura reported a higher holding on 2026-10-08 (kabutan n202610080750), consistent with arbitrage or tendering flow.

evidence.text: City Index Fifth (an affiliate of the former Murakami fund) is running a tender offer for all units at JPY 125,000: no upper limit, a floor of 118,732 units (25.42%), offer period 2026-09-28 to 2026-11-10, with delisting and squeeze-out intended. The REIT's board supports the offer and is neutral on whether to tender. The units have traded at JPY 125,000-125,400 since, so the 15:30 results release (a period already pre-released on 09-25) has nothing to reprice.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the tender was announced the stock has closed within -0.08% to +0.32% of the offer price on every session, including the 2026-10-13 15:30 asset-sale completion and debt-repayment notices and the 2026-10-15 index crash. On 2026-04-13 a profit downgrade with no distribution came while no tender was live, so that reaction is not comparable.
evidence.why_not_priced: It is fully priced, and that is the point: spot JPY 125,100 sits on the JPY 125,000 offer price. If the market expected the print to matter, units would trade away from the offer price or turnover would rise into the release. Instead volume has faded from 33,584 units on 09-28 to 238 this morning. The finding is that the event has nothing to move, so it is [sizing note removed].
evidence.independence: The tender announcement PDF on TDnet via kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925540118/), M&A Online (https://maonline.jp/news/20260925f) and the Yahoo daily tape all independently confirm the price, the period and the pin.

evidence.text: The City Index Fifth tender closes 2026-11-10, and success depends on reaching the 25.42% floor. ATRA and Aya Nomura (19.58%) will not tender. The previous Tosei/GIC offer at the same JPY 125,000 failed in February 2026, so the result (or a counter-bid or price bump) is the real catalyst, and it falls after this window.
Nomura's large-holding change report showing a higher stake, as evidence of tender-arbitrage demand
2026-10-13 completion of the Fukuoka Green Building sale and partial early repayment of borrowings
Counter-bid by Tosei/GIC or anyone else in October 2026: a web search returned nothing and the kabutan news list (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2972) shows no such item to 2026-10-16 09:50 JST
A tender-price amendment (公開買付条件の変更): none found on the kabutan list
A separate 2972 disclosure on 2026-10-16 before the release: none on the kabutan list as of 09:50 JST
Japanese-language search for 2026-10 news on サンケイリアルエステート: only the September tender and the August JCR rating affirmation (A+, stable)

first_hunter_context.bar: Company forecast for FP Aug-2026 (第22期) DPU 3,695 yen incl. 458 yen excess distribution, and FP Feb-2027 DPU 3,719 yen, from the 2026年2月期 決算短信 dated 2026-04-17: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260417/140120260417505962.pdf. No independent consensus (IFIS/四季報) sourced, so sizes are capped small.
first_hunter_context.positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-15: 0.0% disclosed (no position >=0.5%), change 0.0 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per sealed baseline). 信用倍率 20.73 (margin long-heavy, but margin balances in a large REIT are small vs turnover of ~JPY1.27bn/day). No options, no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.341, driven by margin overhang.

evidence.text: NMF has a precedent of announcing a 自己投資口取得 with its October results (2024-10-17, 21,080 units bought 2024-10-18 to 12-05; also July 2024), the unit price is now 134,600 against 142,500 at that 2024 print, and Aug-FP peer GLP REIT announced a JPY10bn (1.62%) buyback with its results on 2026-10-15, so a buyback at this print is plausible but not disclosed.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2024-10-17 results + buyback: +2.18% close-to-close (142,500 -> 145,600), the largest of the last six print reactions (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3462.T?range=3y&interval=1d). Peer GLP REIT on 2026-10-16 morning: +0.47% vs J-REIT ETF 1343 -0.1% after its buyback.
evidence.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced; with no options and zero disclosed shorts there is no instrument expressing the probability, and the unit has drifted down with the sector (-6.3% over 20 sessions, J-REIT ETF 1343 similar) rather than firming into the print as it would if a buyback were anticipated.
evidence.independence: GLP REIT buyback notice 2026-10-15 https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261015551466.pdf; NMF's own record of 2024 buybacks and cancellations in the 2026-02 短信 notes 11-12 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260417/140120260417505962.pdf (same company, different document).

evidence.text: Refinancing in August 2026 was done at a 7-year fixed 2.83565% (MUFG, JPY2.5bn) and floating 1M/3M TIBOR + 0.17-0.26% on JPY23.6bn, after the BOJ's June hike to 1.0%, while the April forecast for FP Feb-2027 assumed JPY3,165m of interest costs with JPY40.1bn more to refinance in that period; earnings for Feb-2027 and the new Aug-2027 forecast face upward interest pressure that ATA/excess distributions (already 824 yen in the Feb-2027 DPU) would have to absorb.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-16 print (headline '今期経常は17%減益へ', DPU held with excess distributions): -0.73%; 2026-04-17 print (guide raised to 3,695 via sale gains): -1.03%. Guidance prints have produced small negatives.
evidence.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the rate rise is public and the sector is down ~19% YTD. What is not priced is how much of it NMF passes into the DPU forecast rather than absorbing with ATA; the unit trades at a ~5.5% yield on the 3,695/3,719 forecasts, which would be visibly higher if a DPU cut were expected.
evidence.independence: Loan notice 2026-08-14 (spreads, floating structure) https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260814/140120260814520996.pdf — same financing, so counted once; macro context (BOJ hike to 1.0% in June, JGB 10y >2.5%) from search snippets only.

evidence.text: The Best Western Hotel Fino Tokyo Akasaka (JPY8.7bn, appraisal NOI JPY385m, 4.4% NOI yield, fully variable rent, acquired 2026-09-01 with own cash) enters the Feb-2027 forecast; the company itself called the impact minor and deferred the revised forecast to this print.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate reaction recorded; the 2026-08-18 acquisition announcement day is not distinguishable from sector moves.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced (public since 2026-08-18 with NOI disclosed); roughly +40 yen/unit per half on ~4.65m units before costs, within normal forecast noise.
evidence.independence: Supplementary deck same day https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260818/140120260818522391.pdf (same deal, counted once).
